newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE DEPLETED AHEAD OF SPRINGBOK CLASH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE DEPLETED AHEAD OF SPRINGBOK CLASH.

text.p: France, already handicapped by the absences of many key players, lost centre Thomas Castaignede and fly-half Alain Penaud on Thursday, two days before the first test against rugby union world champions South Africa.
Castaignede and Penaud have been replaced by Laurent Mazas and uncapped Guillaume Bouic, who will make his international debut in the worst possible conditions.

"We have a lot of absentees, and not minor ones," said coach Jean-Claude Skrela, who was already without captain Philippe Saint-Andre, fellow winger Emile Ntamack, locks Olivier Merle and Olivier Roumat and prop Jean-Louis Jordana.
"But we still aim to win this match."
With half of the team made up of second-choice players, France's spirits were low at their training camp near Bordeaux.
"All these injuries are the result of too many high-level matches, especially in the European Cup," said team manager Jo Maso as he led a dejected Penaud back to the dressing-rooms.
"Players were not able to take the period of rest required ahead of a clash such as this."
Skrela will field an unusual back line. His scrum-half and fly-half have never played together and neither have locks Fabien Pelous and Hugues Miorin.
"It's a very young team and it's probably the first time we've launched such an inexperienced side at such a level. But we had no choice," he said.
Mazas and Bouic were the only two players with smiles on their faces on Thursday. Both were in the Barabarians team which upset the tourists in Brive last week.
Mazas earned his only other cap in a defeat by Argentina in 1992 in Nantes.
"I would have liked to be back in different circumstances but I'll do my best to live up to the challenge," he said.
"It's a gift from heaven," said Bouic, who spent several seasons alongside Philippe Sella at Agen.

Team: 15-Jean-Luc Sadourny, 14-Richard Dourthe, 13-Guillaume Bouic, 12-Stephane Glas, 11-David Berty, 10-Laurent Mazas, 9-Philippe Carbonneau, 8-Thierry Labrousse, 7-Abdelatif Benazzi (cap), 6-Philippe Benetton, 5-Fabien Pelous, 4-Hugues Miorin, 3-Franck Tournaire, 2-Marc de Rougemont, 1-Christian Califano.
